title: George Ellery Hale's inspiring elf or spirit
summary: Jesse Michels tells of George Ellery Hale's inspiring elf or spirit, about early 20th century at Pasadena, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Hale claimed he received creative inspiration from a being, an elf or a spirit, as he described it.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that George Ellery Hale, a scientist tied to Pasadena, California, claimed he got creative inspiration from a being he described as an elf or a spirit. Michels tells it in an episode about NASA and UFOs, as a sign that some of modern science's founders drew on something beyond the ordinary.
